summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Lobby redesign (Phase D) - all features working correctly on mobile viewport (390x844)
passed_tests: Backend API: All 34 backend tests passed (Energy system, Daily missions, Arena/PvP, Regression tests)
Login Flow: Quick Play Demo button login works and navigates to Lobby
Login Flow: Email/password form login (admin@shinobi.com / admin123) works and navigates to Lobby
Lobby Page: Leader Hero Banner renders correctly with full-bleed cinematic design, showing leader name (Blaze Akagi), title, rarity, element, level with gradient scrim overlay
Lobby Page: HUD strip displays Energy (100/100), Ryo (48800), Power (3158) correctly with unboxed glowing readouts
Lobby Page: Sensei Rank (Lv.1) displays in top-right corner
Lobby Page: Continue Mission card visible and navigates to /campaign correctly
Lobby Page: All 7 quick-access tiles render with colored gradients and navigate correctly (Campaign, Spire, Arena, Squad, Roster, Gallery, Summon)
Lobby Page: Energy Widget section present at bottom
Lobby Page: Daily Missions panel present at bottom with 5 missions and Claim buttons functional
Mobile Viewport: NO horizontal scrolling detected on Lobby page (390px = 390px) at top and bottom
Navigation: All tile navigations work correctly to their respective routes
Navigation: TopBar More button opens drawer with additional navigation links (Spire, Arena, Gallery, Team, Ranks, Admin)
Regression: Roster page renders correctly with 12 hero cards in cinematic grid layout
Regression: HeroShowcase modal opens on hero tap and displays full-screen hero details correctly
Regression: NO horizontal scrolling on Roster page (390px = 390px)
Regression: TopBar navigation works consistently across all pages

additional_notes.main_agent_login_issue: The main agent reported login issues during headless testing (form fill + click not triggering navigation). However, in comprehensive testing, BOTH login methods (Quick Play Demo button and email/password form) worked perfectly and navigated to Lobby successfully. The issue appears to be resolved or was environment-specific.
additional_notes.visual_design_assessment: Lobby redesign successfully implements cinematic, mobile-first, artwork-first RPG UI. Key achievements: (1) Full-bleed Squad Leader banner dedicates 60-80% of screen to character artwork, (2) No generic rectangular SaaS cards - using gradient tiles with icons, (3) Unboxed HUD strip with glowing readouts, (4) Proper gradient/glow effects used tastefully, (5) NO horizontal scrolling on mobile viewport, (6) Text has good contrast with background via scrim overlays
additional_notes.regression_status: All previously completed features (Roster, HeroPortrait, HeroShowcase, EliteBurst, TopBar navigation) continue to work correctly with no regressions detected
